description: Market notices (Android MarketNoticeGate.kt / IndicatorAlerts.kt / GasAlertChecker.kt GasAlertLogic / DepegAlarm.kt, CycleCache.kt; iOS ZoneCheck.swift MarketNoticeGate / IndicatorAlerts.swift / GasFees.swift GasAlertCheck / DepegAlarm.swift, CycleCache.swift): the remembered state of a notice only counts for the bound it was stored with - a missing stored bound (null) or a different one (changed, or 0 = switched off in between, MarketAlertReset) counts as changed, so the notice is armed again. boundChanged: Fear & Greed bound; indicatorWasCrossed: 'already beyond' of an indicator bound; gasArmedFor / depegArmedFor: armed state of the gas alarm (gwei / sat/vB) and the USDT depeg alarm (tenths of a percent). indicatorActive: only selectable values (IndicatorAlertKind.choices) are switched on, the threshold is value / scale. zoneRetry: after a failed fetch the zone check is retried at most maxRetries times with doubling pauses (WorkManager backoff on Android, foreground retry on iOS). marketTabTimeouts: hard time limit per market tab section (ms), keys like Android CycleSource.key.

indicatorWasCrossed.name: crossed with another bound: judge anew

gasArmedFor.name: fired at the same bound: stays disarmed

depegArmedFor.name: fired at -0.8 % with threshold 0.5 %, same threshold: stays disarmed
threshold lowered to 0.3 % while the deviation lasts: armed again
switched off and on again (0 stored by MarketAlertReset.depegOff)

indicatorActive.name: value not among the choices is off
